The results are recorded in Figure 9 . The results exhibit a very interesting pattern. For r = 1 , 2 r=1,2 , the results are comparable to those of the even cycle. For r ∈ { 3 , … , 7 } r\in\{3,\dots,7\} , however, the algorithm finds a proper coloring at least 50% of the time, with the success rate increasing in r r , but when it fails to find a proper coloring, it finds one in which the loss is much larger than 0 , causing the algorithm’s average loss to still be large. Additionally, for r ∈ { 3 , … , 7 } r\in\{3,\dots,7\} , when the coloring is not proper, its loss seems to almost always take the same one or two precise values.
